typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SOURCE as integer,
		CID as integer,
		FORM_ID as integer,
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		CONCEPT_VALUE as string,
		USER_ID as integer,
		UPDATE_DATE as timestamp,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string,
		TEXT as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: '[PR_PHARMACY_90_DAY_FAX]
		@INPUT_FILE_NAME =',
	schemaName: '[APP_CPLS]',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(CONCEPT_VALUE_6000 = CONCEPT_VALUE) ~> AdjustCharLenofCONCEPTVALUE
AdjustCharLenofCONCEPTVALUE derive(CONCEPT_VALUE_6000 = CONCEPT_VALUE_6000) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		UPDATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SOURCE as integer,
		USER_ID as integer,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string,
		TEXT as string,
		CONCEPT_VALUE as string,
		FORM_ID as integer,
		CID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CONCEPT_ID,
		UPDATE_DATE,
		SOURCE,
		USER_ID,
		TRANSFER_STATUS,
		TEXT,
		CONCEPT_VALUE = CONCEPT_VALUE_6000,
		FORM_ID,
		CID)) ~> CPMWBFORM
